topPRs.title: Support ZK_DISPUTE_GAME (type 10) in SetDisputeGameArgs
topPRs.author: Inphi
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds game type 10 (`ZKDisputeGame`) to `SetDisputeGameArgs`, so a U22 chain can change its ZK game args (prestate, verifier, challenge and prove durations, challenger bond) through this template. The 140-byte layout follows `OPContractsManagerUtils.makeGameArgs`, and the bounds follow the OPCM StandardValidator ZK checks. As with types 5 and 9, the live impl is kept, because the ZK impl returns 0 from `gameType()`.

The new regression tests run against the `zk-proofs-2` Sepolia devnet, the only Sepolia chain with type 10 set. I ran them locally against a recent block. The earlier `SetDisputeGameArgs` tests need an archive RPC, so I could not run them locally; CI covers them.

Part of https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/proofs-team/issues/7
